title: The Last Transmission
look: warm anamorphic film grade, teal shadows, soft halation on highlights

aria.description: Aria, a weathered deep-space engineer in her 40s, short silver hair, a scar across her left brow, wearing a patched orange EVA suit.

kade.description: Kade, a lanky young comms officer with dark curls and anxious eyes, in a grey station jumpsuit.

shots.prompt: @aria stands at a flickering control panel in a derelict space station corridor, emergency lights pulsing red
shots.motion: slow push in on Aria's face as she realizes the reactor is failing

shots.prompt: @kade hunches over a comms console, static on the screens, reaching for a transmit switch
shots.motion: handheld drift, Kade's hand trembling toward the switch

shots.prompt: @aria and @kade brace against a bulkhead as the corridor shudders, debris drifting past in zero-g
shots.motion: the station lurches; both characters thrown against the wall, sparks arcing
